headline: EU proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners over excess capacity
summary: The US government proposed new tariffs on 14 of its major trading partners to address what it calls structural industrial overcapacity. The proposal was made on Wednesday.
why: Tariffs change the cost of imports and trade flows, affecting exporters, importers and currencies across the countries named. Broad tariff proposals are closely watched by investors for their effect on global growth and sector margins.
why_moved: New US tariff proposals on many major trading partners raise expectations of higher trade costs and retaliation risk. The input does not state market reaction.
original_headline: EU propone nuevos aranceles a 14 socios comerciales por exceso de capacidad
